# Tanmay Ambadkar

> Research portfolio for Tanmay Ambadkar, a PhD student at Penn State University working on safe reinforcement learning, formal methods, and trustworthy AI.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://ambadkar.com/): researcher profile, experience, publications, and research directions.
- [RAMPS](https://ambadkar.com/ramps): Robust Adaptive Multi-Step Predictive Shielding for safe reinforcement learning.
- [RAMPS deep dive](https://ambadkar.com/ramps/blog): technical explanation, experiments, limitations, and source links.
- [D3PO](https://ambadkar.com/d3po): preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning project.
- [AutoSpec](https://ambadkar.com/autospec): specification refinement for reinforcement learning.
- [Extended research context](https://ambadkar.com/llms-full.txt): a longer, LLM-oriented summary of the portfolio and research projects.
